title: config confirm
description: How each type of change asks on this machine, from config confirm, so a reader asks the user the same way the CLI does (G-STACK-13).

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ConfigConfirm, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Each type of change, this app's own picks, the defaults, and the style in use.

types.description: Every type of change e-designer makes, in order, so a reader lists them all.

app.description: The style picked for a type in e-designer's config; a type not listed takes the default.

defaults.description: The style of each type nobody picked.

system.description: The style a change to the system itself asks in, for each type that has one, such as deleting a design; it is never remembered (G-STACK-6).

rows.description: The style in use for each type, and where it comes from.

source.description: product: e-designer's config picks it; default: nobody did.
